Copy the Contents of One Directory into Another Directory [python]

The Code

from pathlib import Path
import shutil

def copy_dir_contents(source_dir, destination_dir):
    destination_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    for item in source_dir.iterdir():
        target = destination_dir / item.name
        if item.is_dir():
            shutil.copytree(item, target, dirs_exist_ok=True)
        else:
            shutil.copy2(item, target)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    copy_dir_contents(Path("input_dir"), Path("output_dir"))

Notes

  • This is what I want most of the time when I'm moving files.

  • It copies the contents of a directory recursirvely to a new location instead of making a copy of the source folder inside the destination.

    That is, this:

    root/source_dir/file.txt

    Goes to:

    root/destination_dir/file.txt

    Instead of:

    root/destination_dir/source_dir/file.txt
